values.description: The seed `receipt` template's `key`, auto-generated (nanoid) on first server startup and specific to this instance's SQLite file. Get the real value from Templates > List Templates, or: sqlite3 pdf_server.db "SELECT key, name FROM templates;" (adjust the path to the production DATABASE_URL).
The seed `sticker` template's `key` — same instance-specific caveat as `templateKey`, just for the `sticker` row instead of `receipt`.
